blind.description: A freestanding section of a stylized rough stone masonry wall. It consists of stacked rounded rectangular cobblestones and flagstones embedded in tan mortar, with larger square-ish grey stones near the base and top, accented with reddish-brown blocks in the upper middle and green moss or grime creeping up the bottom blocks. The top rim is capped by a neat row of dark grey rectangular coping stones with chamfered edges. All surfaces are solid, smooth, fully textured, and continuous with no hovering elements, cracks, or detached shards.
blind.from_above: A long, thin rectangular bar divided into three dark grey capstones, flanked by slightly protruding stone contours.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.3 to 1.4 times the height of the figure (around 7.5 to 8 ft tall) and about 3.5 to 4 ft wide.
